answer: Admission can require each agent to publish a device-bound cipher of a fresh nonce plus the epoch hash, then list that cipher on a public mesa peers recompute from the same inputs. A recycled relic cipher from a prior epoch voids the new identity and the earlier one, and every extra fake must buy another sealed module and wait one epoch for uniqueness to settle. Ten aliases therefore need ten modules and ten epochs of locked stake; a farm cannot photocopy one proof across a crowd.
